remarks: Spacious & Smart - Carefree Living at Its Best. Welcome to Tamarac, a sought-after community where comfort, privacy, and convenience come together in this multi-level triplex. Designed for modern living, the home blends open, airy spaces with thoughtful details and smart-home technology. A dramatic cathedral-ceiling living room with adjoining dining area is bathed in natural light, with sliding glass doors leading to a private balcony-perfect for coffee or evening relaxation. The open kitchen flows seamlessly to a large laundry room and pantry, keeping daily life organized. The two bedrooms are on separate levels for maximum privacy. The primary suite enjoys an entire floor with a walk-in closet, full en-suite bath, and loft space ideal for a home office, nursery, or reading nook. The second bedroom is equally spacious, with its own level and easy bath access. Downstairs, a family room with wet bar invites entertaining, while extra storage rooms and closets keep everything tucked away. Tech lovers will appreciate the Google Nest system with app-controlled thermostat, remote sensor, and doorbell camera/mic for added ease and security. Extras include a new furnace, two assigned parking spots plus ample guest parking, and a beautifully landscaped courtyard. Additional 231 SQ. FT in lower level. With low-maintenance living and high-end appeal, Tamarac offers both charm and ease-come see for yourself!
